# jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_apps (Data Source)

Lists every Jamf Security Cloud access policy application on the tenant. Jamf Security Cloud exposes no filter parameters for applications, so this data source takes no search arguments — filter the result in Terraform.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `ztna:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists every access policy application on the tenant. Jamf Security Cloud exposes no
# filter parameters, so filter the result in Terraform.
data "jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_apps" "all" {}

# Applications still routing traffic directly, which reach their servers without the
# ZTNA tunnel.
output "direct_routed_applications" {
  value = [
    for app in data.jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_apps.all.ztna_apps :
    coalesce(app.name, app.predefined_app_id)
    if app.routing.mode == "Direct device routing"
  ]
}

# Applications any device in the fleet can reach.
output "unrestricted_applications" {
  value = [
    for app in data.jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_apps.all.ztna_apps :
    coalesce(app.name, app.predefined_app_id) if app.all_device_groups
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this data source.
- `ztna_apps` (Attributes List) The access policy applications on the tenant, in the order Jamf Security Cloud returns them. The endpoint accepts no sort parameter, so the order is the server's and should not be relied on — match on `id`, `name` or `predefined_app_id` instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--ztna_apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps`

Read-Only:

- `all_device_groups` (Boolean) Whether every device group may reach this application.
- `app_type` (String) Whether the application is predefined or custom.
- `category` (String) Category the application is classified under.
- `device_group_ids` (List of String) IDs of the device groups that may reach this application.
- `direct_ips_and_subnets` (List of String) Address ranges whose traffic belongs to this application.
- `hostnames` (List of String) Host names whose traffic belongs to this application.
- `id` (String) Application ID assigned by Jamf Security Cloud.
- `name` (String) Application name. Null for a predefined application, whose name belongs to the Jamf-maintained definition.
- `predefined_app_id` (String) ID of the Jamf-maintained definition this application is based on. Null for a custom application.
- `routing` (Attributes) How authorised devices reach this application's servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing))
- `routing_overrides` (Attributes List) Per-group routing that overrides the application's own. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing_overrides))
- `security` (Attributes) What a device must prove before it may reach this application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--security))

<a id="nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps.routing`

Read-Only:

- `gateway_id` (String) ID of the access gateway traffic is routed through.
- `mode` (String) Whether traffic is routed via ZTNA or left to the device.
- `routing_mode` (String) Standard or legacy address resolution.


<a id="nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps.routing_overrides`

Read-Only:

- `device_group_ids` (List of String) IDs of the device groups this override applies to.
- `routing` (Attributes) Routing applied to the groups named above. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing_overrides--routing))

<a id="nestedatt--ztna_apps--routing_overrides--routing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps.routing_overrides.routing`

Read-Only:

- `gateway_id` (String) ID of the access gateway traffic is routed through.
- `mode` (String) Whether traffic is routed via ZTNA or left to the device.
- `routing_mode` (String) Standard or legacy address resolution.



<a id="nestedatt--ztna_apps--security"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps.security`

Read-Only:

- `device_risk` (Attributes) Whether access requires device risk validation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--security--device_risk))
- `jamf_trust` (Attributes) Whether access requires Jamf Trust to be enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--security--jamf_trust))
- `managed_device` (Attributes) Whether access requires the device to be managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ztna_apps--security--managed_device))

### Nested Schema for `ztna_apps.security.device_risk`
